_comment: Storyteller events. Each one breaks exactly one link of the colony.

lightning.name: Lightning
lightning.text: Lightning struck the {target} - the machine is broken and needs repair.

sickness.name: Fever
sickness.text: {target} came down with a fever and can't work for half a day.

cave_in.name: Cave-in
cave_in.text: A cave-in buried part of the deposit - buried under rubble for a while.

wanderer.name: Wanderer
wanderer.text: {target} reached the perimeter and begs to join the colony. Open the Events tab.

pod_crash.name: Escape Pod
pod_crash.text: An escape pod crashed nearby: {target} is wounded. Open the Events tab to rescue.

transport_drop.name: Prisoner Transfer
transport_drop.text: The guards dumped new prisoners: {target} joined the colony.

cargo_pod.name: Cargo Pod
cargo_pod.text: A cargo pod of supplies fell from orbit: {target}.

scout_sighting.name: Scout sighting
scout_sighting.text: A lookout spotted the creatures massing at the {target}.

molt.name: Molt
molt.text: The nests shed their skins and fall quiet a little longer - but what hatches next will be tougher.
